results.change_intent: Upload model files and adapters in parallel using an errgroup and rename req.Name to req.Model in CreateHandler.
results.summary: The parallelization logic is clean and properly synchronizes access to the map fields; however, there is a minor race condition risk when reading and writing `temp` across the two loops.

results.change_intent: Update the test assertion in TestCreateHandler to verify req.Model instead of req.Name to match the renamed field on CreateRequest.
results.summary: The field check was updated to req.Model, but the failure error format string still references req.Name.

issues.comment: The condition was updated to check req.Model, but the error message still logs req.Name, which might be empty or unpopulated when the check fails.
issues.suggestion: Update the format argument in t.Errorf to log req.Model instead of req.Name.

results.change_intent: Replace hardcoded fallback terminal width with the newly defined package constant defaultTermWidth.
results.summary: Clean refactor using the shared package constant instead of a magic number.

results.change_intent: Limit rendered progress lines to fit within the terminal height.
results.summary: Limits lines rendered to terminal height minus 1, but doesn't cap `p.pos` or newline generation accordingly, which breaks cursor repositioning and terminal scrolling.

issues.comment: When `len(p.states) >= termHeight`, `p.pos` is set to `len(p.states)` instead of the number of lines actually printed. On subsequent `render()` calls, `for range p.pos - 1 { fmt.Fprint(p.w, "\033[A") }` moves the cursor up by more lines than were printed. Additionally, inside the loop, the newline condition `i < len(p.states)-1` will emit a newline after every printed line up to `termHeight-1`, printing an extra trailing newline and causing the terminal to scroll off-screen.
issues.suggestion: Determine `numLines := min(len(p.states), max(1, termHeight-1))`, loop over `numLines`, condition newline printing on `i < numLines-1`, and set `p.pos = numLines`.
